system.notes: Half-strength (round up) Narcoject/toxin rounds; damage from the dose. Ranges: the hold-out pistol's, halved (round down) (sr2e weapons: Streetline Special ca17afcb8c61ee53 (hold-out pistol), system 0.109.0). One shot; reload 10 Combat Turns. Special Skill or Quickness Test; no aim enhancers. After firing: +2 to visual tests for (4 − unaugmented Body) Combat Turns, min 1. Implant weapon: pair with the eye-dart cyberware, which carries the Essence and price; this item costs 0¥. "Special Skill or Quickness Test" (the book): the system rolls its skill field, so set it by hand if your character uses a Special Skill. (Cybertechnology p.22.)
